excerpt.text: {"verdict": "REVISE", "issues": ["The plan does not include the required material default/assumption audit. Its assumptions list names the interpreter, dependency policy, DemoDebt conventions and read-only status, but does not record provenance, justification, failure mode, earliest diagnostic and promotion status for material choices such as the interpreter/environment, CPU-only execution, subprocess timeout, rounding/calendar conventions, QuantLib tolerance, no-download policy and adapter-selection rules. Add this audit to the pre-edit step and preserve it in the phase record before any integration or numerical check runs.", "The ledger backend is not selected reproducibly: 'prefer Beancount ... or explicitly identify an available Ledger/hledger backend' leaves the implementation environment-dependent. Predeclare a deterministic candidate order and discovery rule, record all candidate statuses, and require the selected backend's exact version/location, command or API, unit/calendar conventions and actual exchange. If all are unavailable, record that outcome explicitly rather than selecting opportunistically."], "summary": "The P11 plan has a sound bounded baseline, shared-runtime comparison, adapter-record schema, negative checks and explicit nonclaims. It requires revision before execution to satisfy the mandatory default/assumption audit and to make ledger-backend selection reproducible.", "next_actions": ["Revise the P11 plan to add the complete default/assumption audit and deterministic ledger-backend selection rule.", "Then execute the existing bounded implementation
